rejections.name: Network support
rejections.reason: The data sheet prints no network-support figure: its specification list gives "Supported Standards: CDMA, WCDMA, GSM, EDGE, HSPA+, EVDO, LTE and all cellular standards", while "Voice & 4G LTE" is banner text and "all US cell carriers" comes from the overview bullets.

Page 1 lists "Fusion4Home Omni / Whip" with model number SC-PolyH-72-ORA-Kit among the signal booster kits that "ship complete with indoor and outdoor antennas and coax cables", while page 2 gives the booster itself as "Model No. Fusion4Home".
The name is read out of the FCC ID "RSN-FUSION2GO5G" printed in the Fusion2Go XR guides; those documents are the XR’s, and their figures are its.

rejections.name: DIP switch attenuation 1
rejections.reason: Page 19 gives 1 dB as the attenuation DIP switch 1 adds within a bank when the installer turns it on, an adjustment the installer makes rather than a rating of the booster.
